**Finding: compliant** (INSURANCE — Vendor insurance)

Section 18 already meets our preferred position, so no redline was proposed:

- **§ 18.1** — Vendor-side obligation, at Vendor's expense, throughout the term plus one year: CGL USD 1M per occurrence / USD 2M aggregate; workers' compensation as required by law; employer's liability USD 1M; professional E&O USD 2M; cyber and privacy liability USD 5M (Vendor processes Customer Data, so the USD 5M cyber tier is the right benchmark).
- **§ 18.2** — Reputable insurers, primary coverage where customary, certificates of insurance on request, advance notice of cancellation or material reduction, and confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities.

All obligations run against Copperleaf (Vendor), and the limits exceed the fallback (E&O USD 1M / cyber USD 2M), so nothing to negotiate here.
